changelog:
Technical SEO Mastery v1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive technical SEO audit, fix, and monitoring system.
- Covers site health checks, crawlability (robots.txt, XML sitemap), indexability (meta tags, canonicals, redirects), and Core Web Vitals.
- Includes YAML templates and actionable checklists for rapid issue detection and prioritization.
- Supports common SEO troubleshooting, migration prep, performance fixes, and international SEO setup.
- Designed to streamline technical SEO best practices for any website.
